title: Outlook: share proposed meeting times in an email, with one-click booking for one-on-one meetings
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, Outlook licensing and stated documentation gaps are supported. One descriptive detail needs narrowing: Microsoft promises one-click booking, but does not say that inserting availability takes one click.
